source_text: Quoniam quidem multi conati sunt ordinare narrationem rerum, quae in nobis completae sunt, sicut tradiderunt nobis, qui ab initio ipsi viderunt et ministri fuerunt sermonis, visum est et mihi, assecuto a principio omnia, diligenter ex ordine tibi scribere, optime Theophile, ut cognoscas eorum verborum, de quibus eruditus es, veritatem. Multi conati sunt, sed non multi compleverunt. Multi conati sunt ordinare narrationem, sed a Domino electi sunt quattuor evangelistae.
pass_a_gloss: Since many have tried to set in order a narrative of the things fulfilled among us… it seemed good to me also… that you may know the truth of the words in which you were instructed. Many tried, but not many finished; four evangelists were chosen by the Lord.
pass_b_english: [[Since many have undertaken to compile a narrative of the things fulfilled among us >> Bible:Luke 1:1]], Origen opens the Luke homilies: many tried, few finished; the church receives four evangelists chosen by the Lord. Luke writes for Theophilus so he may know the [[truth of the words in which he was instructed >> Bible:Luke 1:4]].
notes: Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
